description: Every pixel whose stable-pass output changed at the golden raster (ADR 0013), with its dd adjudication. c is the golden-raster pixel centre of (x, y) for the corpus viewport (createViewportTransform, prepareRealColumns). Aggregates in semantic-comparison.json and summary.md are derived views.

fieldNotes.analyticError: |lambda_after - lambda_dd|; null when dd did not certify period 4
fieldNotes.beforeError: |lambda_before - lambda_dd| when the pixel was already period 4, else null
fieldNotes.allowance: the certificate allowance A = 64 h + 2^-50 at c (PERFORMANCE-MATHEMATICS 12)
